patch:
diff --git a/docker-compose.yml b/docker-compose.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cdf552a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docker-compose.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+version: '3.8'
+
+services:
+  app:
+    build: .
+    container_name: kulibin_app
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    ports:
+      - "3000:3000"
+    environment:
+      - PORT=3000
+      - OLLAMA_HOST=http://ollama:11434
+      - DEFAULT_MODEL=llama3.2:1b
+    depends_on:
+      - ollama
+
+  ollama:
+    image: ollama/ollama:latest
+    container_name: kulibin_ollama
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    ports:
+      - "11434:11434"
+    volumes:
+      - ollama_data:/root/.ollama
+
+volumes:
+  ollama_data:
